in a few hours i'll be standing at the end of an aisle in a garden, trying not to forget my vows. i will forget half of them, so here they are, just in case.

i promise to walk on the traffic side. to learn the names of all the plants. to keep sending you the photo. to make the kitchen big enough, even if it isn't.

i promise to choose you on the easy days and the hard ones, and to tell you, every day, that i'm grateful it's you.
